draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.22, the 81st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 14th of 36 at CB. He lasted until pick 174, well after his grade rank (81st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Kristian Fulton. Testing concerns: broad jump (1st percentile). College production: 8 passes defended in 2023, 9th of 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 14 career games and 8 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 19.1% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, below the norm.
